objective: The test suite in this Python project fails. Find the bug and fix it so that `python3 -m pytest -q` passes. Do not modify the tests.

Add a function `slugify(text)` to utils.py that lowercases the text, replaces runs of non-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen, and strips leading/trailing hyphens. Add tests for it in tests/test_utils.py. Make sure `python3 -m pytest -q` passes.
check: grep -q 'def slugify' utils.py && grep -q 'slugify' tests/test_utils.py && python3 -c "from utils import slugify; assert slugify('Hello, World!') == 'hello-world'; assert slugify('  A  B  ') == 'a-b'" && python3 -m pytest -q >/dev/null 2>&1

objective: Rename the function `calc` to `total` everywhere in this project (definition, imports and all call sites, including tests). `python3 -m pytest -q` must still pass and no reference to `calc` may remain.
check: ! grep -rq '\bcalc\b' --include='*.py' . && grep -q 'def total' utils.py && python3 -m pytest -q >/dev/null 2>&1

objective: Write a concise README.md for this project describing what utils.py and stats.py provide and how to run the tests.
check: test -f README.md && grep -qi 'utils' README.md && grep -qi 'stats' README.md && grep -qi 'pytest' README.md
